text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's been a few days since I started my
life
as a trainer at Tracen
Academy.

Error. Specified coordinates do not
correspond with target location.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While walking around the shopping
district, I notice an Umamusume
standing
in the middle of the path.

GPS is currently unresponsive. Detecting a
shift in emotional
state—"despair" has
been identified.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Tracen Academy trainer badge
confirmed. Hello. My name is
Mihono
Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I am currently experiencing "despair"
because I am unable to locate
the new
training equipment store.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Upon inquiry, a passerby instructed me to
walk straight for approximately
one-hundred meters. However, the
provided data
appears incorrect.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In addition, my mobile device is
malfunctioning. I am unable to access
the
GPS.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sensing her obvious confusion, I pull out
my phone and begin to
search on the
internet.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I quickly find the store—just a mere 42
meters away. Squinting ahead,
I can make
out the sign from here.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Pardon. Please define "a bit more."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If possible,
please quantify "a bit more" in
numerical terms.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ..."Around?"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for confirming that the store is
42 meters ahead. It seems
that my original
informant had miscalculated the distance.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, this could have been avoided
had I done sufficient research. I will log
this event in my database to prevent
future
occurrences.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Once again,
thank you for your assistance.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Destination—42 meters ahead.
Commencing navigation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I keep watch as she heads down the street,
then disappears into the
correct shop.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day after that odd encounter, I stop
by a mock race, hoping to
scout a few
students.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, isn't Mihono Bourbon here today? I
heard she did well in her
races before
admission to Tracen.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that cyborg of a student?
I think I saw
her around, though I
wouldn't get my
hopes up if I were you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The voices of excited trainers drown each
other out as everyone gathers information.
An electric buzz fills the air as the
clock counts
down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bang!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sound of the opening gates echoes
through the stadium as
participants charge
down the track.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Do you see the one in front? Look at her
go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Leading the pack is Mihono Bourbon,
determined to put distance
between her
and the rest.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
The rumors were right—her speed is really
something else. This
newcomer's gonna
change the game for sprinters!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon charges ahead of her
opponents with overwhelming
force. Her
lone figure quickly approaches the goal.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without losing her lead even once, she
calmly crosses the finish line
in a
convincing show of power.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A sense of complete awe washes over
me—it's almost hard to believe
the lost
Umamusume I met days ago is the same
person!

text_block_list.name: New Trainer
text_block_list.text:
That potential... I gotta scout her before
the others do!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You're too late.
She's already got a trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And sure enough, I find Mihono Bourbon
talking to someone.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Looks like she's with a veteran too. Agh,
better luck next time I guess.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I'm surprised you didn't know. That
trainer's been gushing about how
he'll
make Bourbon the perfect sprinter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reluctantly accepting defeat, I decide to
quietly support Mihono
Bourbon from the
sidelines.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the sun long past set, I start making
my way back home—only to
notice
someone on the track.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she's doing some evening
training by herself.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Hah... 1,800 meters completed. 1,200
meters remaining. Time—2:04.
Speed
insufficient to meet target!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curious, I listen to Mihono Bourbon
calculating her time and
distance—until
something hits me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My mind reels at the number. It's
practically unheard of for pre-debut
racers to attempt such long distances.
The risk of
injury is too great!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Ahh... argh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Panicking, I rush to Mihono Bourbon's side
to check on her.
